newsitem.title: USA: Emery Worldwide starts '97 well at Newark.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide starts '97 well at Newark.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 7 (Renter) - John Zaras, Vice President of Emery Worldwide, Eastern division, told Reuters Friday the growth at the company's Newark International airport service centre looked "favourable".

Zaras said the carrier has seen a 30 percent plus increase in domestic revenue comparing January 1997 to January 1996. The carrier has also realised a 23 percent plus increase in international revenue, reflecting the same January 1997 versus January 1996 statistics.

"We're quite optimistic as upward trend looks favourable, we're off to a good year", Zaras said when asked to forecast the reminder of 1997 at Newark Internatianal airport. Emery was named as one of the top ten cargo carriers at Newark International airport in 1996 by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey.
